caveats: This is an artifact diagnostic, not a source-classification benchmark.
Random folds answer whether the provenance imprint is PRESENT, not whether it generalizes to unseen sources (use a leave-one-source-out transfer test for that).
High recoverability means features can encode collection-associated variation; it does not by itself prove the cause or a downstream shortcut.
recommendation: HIGH RISK: provenance is strongly recoverable. Treat source as a potential confound, apply collection/normalization controls, and report strict source-held-out downstream evaluation before making representation claims.
